summary: Every to-do says what to do, has one main button, and speaks your app's language.
notes: Each to-do is titled by what you do ("Add a Vercel token so every push deploys your site") and has one main button, the same on the list and in its panel.
A Mac or web app is no longer told about iPhones, TestFlight, Google Play or store listings. Steps for a store show only if your app is in it.
launchpad writes your privacy policy and terms itself, so it no longer asks you to check pages that don't exist yet.
If Apple is waiting for you to accept an updated agreement, Mission Control says so in Apple's words, and the card clears once you accept.
Release with one Approve, add TestFlight testers by email, and see each build on Testing & builds.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
